tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The table the sheets lie on: the page margin, the bay, the gap between sheets. Never flat in a bay: it is lit by ground-lit and by the signal. Comes from the project's tone (Datum.palette).

tokens.name: ground-lit
tokens.usage: The ambient light on the ground: the wide pool behind the subject of a bay and at the top of a page. Same hue as ground, lighter. A fill for light only, never for a block.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Every surface that holds content. Text sits here. Never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: One step off the sheet: soft cards, segmented controls, code, the side faces of a stack figure.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rows, mosaic dividers. Decoration, not a control border.

tokens.name: off
tokens.usage: Inactive shapes only: steps not reached, unlit cells of a bar, a disabled outline. Never text.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: The mid tone, the same in both themes: placeholder thumbs, the second series of a chart. Never text on sheet in Day.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, solid controls, outlines of controls, plate furniture, the lines of a figure. 7:1 or more on ground, sheet and mist.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, input outlines at rest, data labels, the quiet half of a title. 4.5:1 on ground, ground-lit, sheet and mist in both themes.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and end cells on an ink fill.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one colour, and it is light: the datum line and its glow, the key light on the ground, the datum contour of a figure, lamps, the pulse, the leading cell of a bar. As a solid fill once a view: the signal button, or one signal field. Comes from the project's colour reference. Shapes and text of 24px and up only; under 3:1 on ground in Day, so nothing has to be read from it there.

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Signal as small text on sheet or mist: an error line, a wrong answer. 4.5:1 on both. Changes with signal.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a signal fill: the datum key, a signal tag, the signal button, a signal field, the dark stripe of the hazard band. 4.5:1 on signal.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Fill of glass. Glass exists only where something floats over a picture, a figure or the bay: the nav block, callout chips, readout panels, the dock.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The one-pixel rim of glass.

styles.name: mega
styles.usage: The one word of a view set as large as the view allows: across a sheet as a band, or behind the subject of a bay as a ghost. One short word, the project's name or its subject. One per view; never with a second display title of the same weight beside it.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The hero title of a Persuade view: heavy, tight, sentence case, two short lines. One per view. Scales down on narrow screens.

styles.name: display-light
styles.usage: The calm voice of the same title, for a view led by a dark picture or a figure. A view takes display or display-light, never both.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles and the title of an app screen. Sentence case, so a question or a task stays easy to read.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Names inside a row, a card or a notice.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every unit is measured against one datum before it leaves the floor.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase. Button text, tags, tabs, the name over a group of data, set in square brackets there. Never over a title.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: A live figure in a glass panel over a picture or a figure: light, tabular. On a sheet a big figure takes the plate face instead.

styles.name: plate-xl
styles.usage: The one big figure of a view. Its corners are cut like the components. Uppercase, tabular.

styles.name: plate-l
styles.usage: Plate numbers and codes: PL.01, DTM-01.

styles.name: plate-m
styles.usage: Units beside a big figure, the heading of an alert.

styles.name: plate-s
styles.usage: Key letters in choices and the datum symbol.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Values, measurements, ids, timestamps, hex codes. Tabular. Only for data, never as a look.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Uppercase plate furniture: sheet lines, ruler figures, labels in a facts table, the labels of a figure. Never the only place a fact appears.

styles.name: word
styles.usage: The vertical katakana word in the bay, in signal. One word per view, the project name or its subject.

styles.name: word-s
styles.usage: The same word set small in a line of type.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a lamp and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a tag; label to its control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between buttons; end cell to label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; between blocks of the hero column.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sheet padding; the gutter between column and bay; button side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The ground margin around a sheet; between groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections of a sheet.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Above a section heading in long text.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Air above the last block of a Persuade view.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner is square. Shape comes from cuts, never from rounding.

tokens.name: cut-s
tokens.usage: The 45-degree cut on small labels: tags, callout chips, icon cells.

tokens.name: cut-m
tokens.usage: The cut on what you press: buttons, choices, the nav block, the dock.

tokens.name: cut-l
tokens.usage: The cut on blocks: cards, glass panels, notices.

tokens.name: cut-xl
tokens.usage: The cuts of the bay, and the inner corner wherever a container bites into it.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines, plate furniture, the lines of a figure.

tokens.name: stroke-line
tokens.usage: Outlines of controls and tags, the datum contour of a figure.

tokens.name: stroke-datum
tokens.usage: The datum line and the focus ring.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, fields, switches, choices.

tokens.name: control-s
tokens.usage: Small buttons; tabs; the end cell inside a control.

tokens.name: plate-margin
tokens.usage: Ground shown around and between sheets.
